faceEvidence.name: 비구술
cues: ‘round body’ → 턱선 · 턱끝 부드럽고 둥근 턱

faceRationale: The round blue body and circular dark eyes support a rounded human contour, rounded short brows and a soft nose; the long slender legs are interpreted as a compact adult silhouette, never extra limbs.
planning_decision: Changed place, activity, garment silhouettes and direction/frame pairs from the inspected recent images; each character has three distinct categories, expressions, poses, directions and frames.
wear: Blue close-fitting plates with semicircular pink markings; a small yellow cap-shaped headpiece with one slim antenna ornament. The water-skating leg motif becomes narrow sweeping shin guards, never extra limbs.
finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly rounded face, balanced length, medium width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; short rounded brows; rounded soft tip nose; thin lips.
faceComparison: Compared actual light pictures with Gardevoir, Pelipper, Ralts and Kirlia: Surskit has wider round eyes, shorter round jaw, shorter brows and rounded nose; facial proportions were judged apart from hair and head ornaments.
